message:
The specimen now sits cleanly inside the plate: seven alternating leaves, thin stem with a bud at the tip, no collisions with either label, the scale bar grounded at bottom-right, and the whole plant tucked between the plate rules. The hero reads clearly at gallery thumbnail size with an unmistakable identity, and the call to action stays visible.

The design is complete and verified at the desktop presentation. Final state of the delivery:

**What this is** — a Muse-authored concept sample for 「山野之间」, a fictional nature-living brand. Not a re-skin of the previous concept: the herbarium **collection-dossier system (NO. 01–06)** now organizes the whole page, so the specimen, the field almanac, and the product cards all speak the same archival language.

**Structure** — asymmetric 5:7 hero with a live specimen plate → story (narrow text column + bare data ledger, no card wrapper) → field almanac as an indented list marking the current season → three expandable product dossiers with the middle column dropped → seasonal-letter subscription → colophon stating the concept nature.

**The two distinctive relations** — the specimen plate responds to 晨/午/暮 (leaf color, paper tone, halo, rules, caption and the left-hand reading line all shift together); every artifact opens its dossier **in place**, never in a modal or a new page.

**Chinese typography** — 宋体 carries body copy at 15–17px and headlines; small labels fall back to sans/mono, per the CJK rule that 宋体 below 15px muddies.

**States covered** — moment toggle (aria-pressed), dossier expand (aria-expanded), season filter with an invitation-style empty state that returns focus to the current season, and subscription with validation, disabled, success and a way back.

**Unverified, stated plainly** — I checked the JS syntax, the three-file split, and the absence of network dependencies; I also corrected the specimen artwork across five rounds based on real screenshots. I did **not** test at 390px on a real device, did not walk the full-page or mobile interaction paths, and did not check 200% text zoom. Responsive reflow and interaction behavior remain unverified, and no automated browser run was performed.
